description: This file contains helper functions for error sanitization, error extraction, validation error handling, and error formatting related to embedder validation in a software project.

classes.name: HttpError
classes.description: Interface for HTTP errors with optional status and response properties.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Interface for validation errors with optional status, message, name, and code.

methods.name: sanitizeErrorMessage
methods.description: Sanitizes error messages by removing sensitive info like URLs, file paths, emails, and IP addresses.

methods.name: getErrorMessageForStatus
methods.description: Maps HTTP status codes to localized error messages based on embedder type.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts HTTP status code from various error object formats.

methods.name: extractErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts error message string from various error object formats.

methods.name: handleValidationError
methods.description: Handles validation errors, returning a standardized validation result with error messages.

methods.name: withValidationErrorHandling
methods.description: Wraps an async validation function with standardized error handling.

methods.name: formatEmbeddingError
methods.description: Creates an Error object with a formatted message based on error type and retry attempts.
